//: PreToolUse hooks for cdk-real-drift. The repo now has a GitHub remote and a PR-based flow, so the cdkd-derived branch-protection and verify-pr-merge gates are active (R83). Wired (per .markgate.yml, ONLY to gates with companion skills): check-gate blocks `git commit` unless check+docs markers are fresh; branch-gate blocks commit/push directly on main; main-tree-branch-gate blocks `git switch` / `git checkout` onto a feature branch when the TARGET tree is the MAIN checkout (branch-gate fires on the symptom, at commit/push time; this one fires on the cause, and passes every switch made inside a `.worktrees/` lane) -- TWO entries, one per verb, because an `if` carries exactly one pattern (go-to-k/cdk-real-drift#1801); bughunt-clean-gate blocks `git commit`/`gh pr create`/`gh pr merge` while the COMMITTING owner's bughunt sentinel is non-empty — per-owner, so a peer session's live hunt does not block an unrelated commit; deploy-autoarm arms a PER-SESSION token (not a global one) so your own deploy blocks your own commit but not a peer's (the legacy flat .markgate-bughunt-pending stays a global block); armed by /hunt-bugs via bughunt-track.sh add before any integ deploy; released by bughunt-track.sh clear only after every tracked stack is deleted + SWEEP CLEAN; stale-base-gate blocks `git push` of a branch that sits on origin/main yet reverts recent main work (the stale-base soft-reset clobber); verify-pr-gate blocks `gh pr create`/`gh pr merge` unless the verify-pr marker is fresh (EXEMPT for docs/tooling-only diffs touching no src/**); non-english-text-gate blocks `gh pr create`/`edit`/`merge` when the PR diff contains non-English text (the OSS English-only rule); issue-dup-check-gate blocks `gh issue create` (and the REST mint `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/issues`) unless the body carries a `Dup-check:` line recording that the OPEN issue list was searched for an issue already naming this root cause — `gh issue edit`/`gh issue comment` are deliberately NOT gated, because folding a finding into the issue that already covers it is the outcome the gate steers toward; deploy-autoarm-gate ARMS a PER-SESSION `autoarm-<session>` token the moment a deploy-shaped command (`aws cloudformation deploy`/`create-stack`/`update-stack`, `cdk deploy`, `sam deploy`) runs, so THIS session's commit/PR gate then blocks until the account is verified clean via /sweep-resources — this closes the 'deployed a throwaway live-test but never called bughunt-track.sh add' hole; worktree-guard (matcher Edit|Write|NotebookEdit) blocks an Edit/Write to the MAIN checkout's `src/**`/`tests/**` while a `.worktrees/` worktree exists (CLAUDE.md: main is integration-only; direct main edits have caused cross-session collisions — the #408 contamination). Stop hook: stop-cleanup-warn warns at session end if THIS session/owner's sentinel is still armed (per-session, mirrors bughunt-clean-gate — a peer's live hunt does not trigger a false reminder; deployed but not cleaned up — closes the 'deploy then end without committing' hole; warn-only so /hunt-bugs can keep resources live between turns). NOT wired: pr-review and the read-only integ gate — they have no companion skill in cdkrd (pr-review is multi-agent; cdkrd has no providers/state/destroy integ), so wiring them would brick the flow.
